headline: Ikea Operator Ingka Boosts Net Profit by 9B Kronor Led by Sweden Growth
summary: Ikea retail operator Ingka Group lifted annual profit by nearly 9 billion Swedish kronor despite a broader global sales slowdown, bolstered by half a billion kronor revenue expansion in Sweden.
why: Ingka Group accounts for the vast majority of worldwide Ikea retail operations; its performance provides a key health check on global home furnishings demand.

impacts.name: Ingka Group
impacts.why: Profit rose by nearly 9 billion kronor on cost controls and Swedish market sales resilience.
